clue.text: Suggestion leads to autumn bonanza

parts.note: a suggestion or hint, as in 'get wind of' something
fall is the American word for autumn

explanation.surface: A hint points towards a rich autumn harvest.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden unexpected gain of money or luck is a bonanza, like fruit blown down from a tree.

clue.text: Right in withholding a double

indicators.note: the right-hand letter and the single letter are placed inside the word 'with'

parts.note: read as two words, 'with holding': the word with is the container that holds

explanation.surface: Someone is legally right to withhold a stunt double's pay.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'withholding' into 'with holding': WITH holds R (right) and A, giving W-RA-ITH.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghostly apparition of a living person, a doppelganger, is called their double.

clue.text: Girl takes name from the man

parts.note: Norma is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl adopts her name from a particular man.
explanation.definitionFit: Norman is a male first name, so it stands for a man.

clue.text: Member not tight, and is free to travel

parts.note: a foot is a limb or member of the body
loose means not tight

explanation.surface: A limb that is not stiff can roam freely.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unattached and able to wander where one pleases is being free to travel.

clue.text: Delivering coach for disembarkation here

parts.note: landing a blow or a fish is delivering it
a stage, short for stagecoach, is a horse-drawn coach

explanation.surface: Dropping off a coach at a place where passengers get off.
explanation.definitionFit: A pier or jetty where boat passengers step ashore is the place for disembarkation.

clue.text: One may be fired and end up a jail-bird

parts.note: to end up something is to turn out to be it
a con is a convict, a jail-bird

explanation.surface: Someone sacked from a job ends up in prison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fired' suggests sacking, but a beacon is a signal fire that is lit.
explanation.definitionFit: A signal fire on a hill is lit, or fired, to send a warning.

clue.text: A priest trapped half of them in the ointment

indicators.note: the priest's name encloses the other letters as if it had caught them

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Bible who raised Samuel

indicators.note: only the second two of the four letters of them are used

explanation.surface: A clergyman caught half the group in some greasy salve.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemi is an aromatic resin used in making ointments and varnishes, so it stands for the salve itself.

clue.text: Form of magic Pan found offensive

indicators.note: a new form of these letters means they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some kind of magic that Pan found rude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Offensive' looks like an adjective, rude; it is the noun, a military drive. 'Form of' rearranges MAGIC PAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A planned military push or political drive is an offensive.

clue.text: Having recently become a union member

definitions.text: Having recently become a union member

parts.words: Having recently become a union member
parts.note: sounds like joining a trade union, but the union is a marriage

explanation.definitionFit: Someone just married has joined the union of matrimony.

clue.text: In flight, though originating in a Yorks river

indicators.note: the word for originating goes inside the river's name

parts.note: the Aire is a river in Yorkshire, a county in northern England
born means come into being, originating

explanation.surface: Something flying, though it began beside a Yorkshire river.
explanation.definitionFit: Flying through the air is being in flight.

clue.text: Largely disreputable quarters for one often 9

indicators.note: most of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: seamy means sordid or disreputable
E and W, east and west, are two compass quarters

explanation.surface: Mostly shady lodgings for a frequent flyer.
explanation.walkthrough: '9' points to the answer at 9 across: a gull is often in flight.
explanation.definitionFit: A gull is a bird often seen in flight over the sea.

clue.text: She's French, but she's holding a mass protest

annotationWithheld.why: She's French, but she's holding a mass protest (12): MA (she) + IS holding DEMO, then ELLE, needs 'she' twice and French ELLE from the definition; no parse gives every letter with each word doing one job
annotationWithheld.clue: She's French, but she's holding a mass protest

clue.text: Subaltern returns carrying uncooked fish

indicators.note: the reversed abbreviation holds the next word inside it
the abbreviation for the officer is read backwards

parts.note: Lt, lieutenant, is a subaltern officer
raw means uncooked

explanation.surface: A junior officer comes back with raw fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fish' is the verb here, not the noun the surface suggests; 'returns' signals reading the officer's abbreviation backwards before it carries the second piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Dragging a large net behind a boat is a way to fish.

clue.text: One girl holds another to be fictitious

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the first girl's name has the second one inside it

parts.note: Mary is a girl's name
Gina is another girl's name

explanation.surface: One girl keeps another as a made-up friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Something existing only in the mind is made-up, fictitious.

clue.text: Pinetop Smith's noted rhymes?

parts.note: a rhyming doubled name for the piano style of the 1920s pianist Pinetop Smith, set down in musical notes

explanation.definitionFit: Pinetop Smith's 1928 record made this rolling blues piano style famous, and its name is a rhyming pair.

clue.text: Drink for ape-man who's swallowed a cigarette-end

parts.note: an orang is an orang-utan, an ape

indicators.note: the man's name takes the single letter inside it

parts.note: Ed is a man's name

indicators.note: the final letter of the word cigarette

explanation.surface: A drink for a caveman who has gulped down a cigarette butt.
explanation.definitionFit: A fizzy citrus soft drink is a drink.

clue.text: Rally and do a bit of cooking

definitions.meaning: a motorcycle rally over rough ground
to ... eggs is to cook them

explanation.definitionFit: A cross-country motorcycle race, and a way of preparing eggs by stirring them in a pan.

clue.text: Even the spineless type will live off the workers

definitions.text: Even the spineless type will live off the workers

parts.words: Even the spineless type will live off the workers
parts.note: sounds like a jibe at idle exploiters, but the workers are insects, and this creature, unlike the spiny echidna, has no spines

explanation.definitionFit: This toothless mammal feeds on worker ants and termites; the spiny echidna is also given its name.

clue.text: Following tradition and meeting a student

parts.note: a convention is a large meeting
L is a learner, a student driver in Britain

explanation.surface: A traditional gathering welcomes a student.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping to accepted customs is following tradition.

clue.text: Prohibit stories from this Central American republic

parts.note: to ban is to prohibit
ana is a collection of anecdotes or stories

explanation.surface: Banning tales from a small Central American state.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition depends on the phrase 'banana republic', a small unstable state dependent on fruit exports.
explanation.definitionFit: A small Central American state run for fruit exports is called a banana republic.

clue.text: Vessel jointly operated by Polly and Sukey

definitions.text: Vessel jointly operated by Polly and Sukey

parts.words: Vessel jointly operated by Polly and Sukey
parts.note: in the nursery rhyme Polly puts this pot on and Sukey takes it off again

explanation.definitionFit: A pot for boiling water is a vessel, the one in the rhyme 'Polly put the kettle on'.

clue.text: Court opera involved a theatre cat

indicators.note: these letters are tangled up into a new order

parts.note: Gus is the theatre cat in T. S. Eliot's Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats

explanation.surface: A court opera features a cat from the theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: The Areopagus was the supreme judicial council of ancient Athens, a court.

clue.text: Clearly it's a stitch

definitions.meaning: ... used as an adverb, as in '... wrong', means clearly

explanation.definitionFit: Plain means obviously or clearly, and is also the simple knit stitch in knitting.

clue.text: One of those open spaces found eternally in Florida?

definitions.text: One of those open spaces found eternally in Florida?

parts.words: One of those open spaces found eternally in Florida?
parts.note: the Florida wetlands have a name that splits into a word for 'always' plus the plural of a woodland clearing

explanation.definitionFit: An open space in a wood is a clearing; the Florida Everglades take their name partly from it.

clue.text: Keys given to carrier to sell down the river

parts.note: B is a musical key
E is another musical key
a tray is used to carry things

explanation.surface: Handing keys to a porter so as to double-cross someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To sell someone down the river is an idiom for being treacherous to them.

clue.text: How agreeable it was to know Mr Lear

definitions.text: How agreeable it was to know Mr Lear

parts.words: How agreeable it was to know Mr Lear
parts.note: recalls the opening line of Edward Lear's comic self-portrait poem about meeting him

explanation.definitionFit: Edward Lear's poem begins 'How pleasant to know Mr Lear', so agreeable is the poem's word in synonym form.

clue.text: Commission for royal artist, eventually

annotationWithheld.why: Commission for royal artist, eventually (6): ER (royal) + RA (artist) gives ERRA, but 'eventually' gives no ND; the scan prints the clue the same way, so the wordplay is short of letters

clue.text: For instance, breaks engagement involving the Spanish envoy

indicators.note: the abbreviation for an example splits the appointment word open
the appointment word also wraps around the Spanish article, so both short pieces sit inside it

parts.note: a date is an engagement or appointment
el is Spanish for 'the'
eg is the abbreviation for 'for example'

explanation.surface: For example, an envoy breaks off an engagement with Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaks' and 'involving' both put pieces inside DATE: EL and EG sit side by side within it, D-ELEG-ATE.
explanation.definitionFit: A person sent to represent others is an envoy.
